description: Common Model of Cognition on Claude Code: Claude is the central pattern matcher and action selector; the plugin supplies a small working memory, separate procedural and declarative stores, quantitative metadata, and learning as a side effect of work
principles: working memory is the only hub
hooks are the architecture; prompts are the content
theory: Laird, Lebiere and Rosenbloom (2017), A Standard Model of the Mind, AI Magazine 38(4) 13-26

description: The cognitive cycle: one model step between tool batches
Declarative memory: semantic and episodic chunks; one best chunk per cue, by activation
Motor: write-side tools are the only way to change the world
Perception: senses feed the percept buffer, compressed
Procedural memory: skills as explicit productions over the model's implicit procedures
Working memory: named buffers, each holding at most one chunk (imaginal up to 5)
